claim_boundary: Every A0 literal obligation was executed on the one bound candidate, with its real result and the receipt's name and digest. It does not claim A0 is complete (owner ruling R4 and the closing commit remain), does not amend the A0 specification or the governing plan, adds no register row, and changes no audit, ledger, manifest or checklist.

candidate.binding_rule: Bind the final candidate commit (40 hex) and a clean `git status --porcelain` before any obligation result is written; a result from any other commit is not admissible here.
